title: In the Flow

lines.text: I was running every road
Chasing signs I didn't know
Living loud and sleeping light
Looking for you every night
Every city, every shore
Always reaching out for more
Couldn't see the current then
It was carrying me to when
You walked in like morning does
Quiet, golden, sure, because
Something bigger than us two
Had been pulling me to you
Felt the whole world slow its spin
Just to let your light come in
With you, I'm in the flow
And I'm never letting go
Every door just opens wide
Every star is on our side
With you, I'm in the flow
And I'm never letting go
Now your hand is in my hand
And I finally understand
When you stop the push and fight
Everything just falls in line
Coffee steam and window rain
Even Mondays feel the same
Like the universe said yes
And it's wearing your blue dress
You laugh and the whole room glows
Where it comes from, no one knows
The same love that lights the sky
Is looking at me through your eyes
Felt the whole world slow its spin
Just to let your light come in
With you, I'm in the flow
And I'm never letting go
Every door just opens wide
Every star is on our side
With you, I'm in the flow
And I'm never letting go
There's a river under everything
It carried me through the wandering
I don't need to know how far it goes
I just hold you close and let it flow
Love like the sun loves, asking nothing back
I'll love you like that, I'll love you like that
Felt the whole world slow its spin
Just to let your light come in
With you, I'm in the flow
And I'm never letting go
Every door just opens wide
Every star is on our side
With you, I'm in the flow
And I'm never letting go
Just to let your light come in
With you, I'm in the flow
And I'm never letting go
Every door just opens wide
Every star is on our side
With you, I'm in the flow
No, I'm never letting go
In the flow
With you, I'm home
